title: Interest on Delayed Universal Life Insurance Surrender Payments
content:
Where the net surrender payment on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is made some days after the surrender's effective date, delayed-payment interest is added to it. The interest follows the days from the effective date to the payment date.

**Standard.**

| Days from the effective date to the payment date | Annual delayed-payment rate |
|---|---|
| **30** or more (the long delay days) | Long delay rate, **6%** (0.06) |
| **7** to 29 (at least the short delay days, fewer than 30) | Short delay rate, **3%** (0.03) |
| Fewer than 7 | Nothing |

The interest is the cash surrender value times that rate for those days over 365. It is added to the net surrender payment before that payment is rounded to the cent.

**Worked figures (hypothetical; cash surrender value $185460.00).**

| Days | Interest |
|---|---|
| 6 | none |
| 10 | $185460.00 times 0.03 times 10 over 365, $152.4329 |
| 29 | $185460.00 times 0.03 times 29 over 365, $442.0553 |
| 41 | $185460.00 times 0.06 times 41 over 365, $1249.9496 |

The days count from the effective date, which is the date the signed surrender request was received.
